name: Longsword
description: A versatile martial weapon favored by knights and soldiers for its balance between power and precision.

name: Shortsword
description: A light, quick martial weapon ideal for dual-wielding or stealthy combat.

name: Greataxe
description: A massive two-handed martial weapon that delivers devastating blows, favored by barbarians.

name: Longbow
description: A ranged martial weapon with impressive range, requiring significant strength to draw.

name: Dagger
description: A simple weapon that is easy to conceal and can be thrown, making it universally useful.

name: Leather Armor
description: Light armor made of supple leather, offering basic protection without impeding movement.

name: Chain Mail
description: Heavy armor made of interlocking metal rings, providing strong protection at the cost of mobility.

name: Plate Armor
description: The finest heavy armor, consisting of shaped, interlocking metal plates covering the entire body.

name: Shield
description: A wooden or metal shield carried in one hand, providing a bonus to Armor Class.

name: Backpack
description: A leather pack carried on the back, capable of holding 1 cubic foot or 30 pounds of gear.

name: Rope (50 feet)
description: Hempen rope with 2 Hit Points that can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check. Can support up to 3,000 pounds.

name: Torch
description: A torch burns for 1 hour, providing Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. Can also be used as an improvised weapon dealing 1 Fire damage.

name: Rations (1 day)
description: Dry foods suitable for extended travel, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts. One day's supply.

name: Potion of Healing
description: A character who drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points. Drinking or administering a Potion of Healing takes a Bonus Action.

name: Thieves' Tools
description: This set of tools includes a small file, a set of lock picks, a small mirror mounted on a metal handle, a set of narrow-bladed scissors, and a pair of pliers. Proficiency with these tools lets you add your Proficiency Bonus to ability checks made to disarm traps or open locks.

name: Herbalism Kit
description: This kit contains a variety of instruments such as clippers, mortar and pestle, and pouches and vials used by herbalists. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your Proficiency Bonus to ability checks made to identify or apply herbs and to create antitoxins and Potions of Healing.

name: Smith's Tools
description: These special tools include the items needed to pursue a smith's craft: hammers, tongs, charcoal, rags, and a whetstone. Proficiency with these tools lets you add your Proficiency Bonus to ability checks made to forge, repair, or identify metal objects.
